description: This is a configuration/include file for setting up machine-specific and architecture-specific build parameters for ARMv5, including DSP and VFP features, for a build system likely based on Yocto/BitBake. It defines tuning features, architecture options, and includes other configuration snippets.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Function to check if a string contains a specific value within a list or set, used to conditionally assign variables based on TUNE_FEATURES.
